name: list
description: List every dossier toil can see, where each lives, and any that are broken

name: show
description: Print a dossier, and the connection, environment and inputs it gives each area

name: check
description: Check a dossier locally: its schema, its connections and hosts, its remotes. Contacts no service.

name: context
description: Show which dossier a folder resolves to, and why

name: brief
description: Brief one dossier by code: what needs a person, under one reason each, and what to do first, from OWI records you pass (local only)

name: init
description: Create a dossier in your own folder (~/.toil/dossiers), or with --shared in a repository for the team

name: add-repo
description: Add a repository to a dossier, by its folder or its remote URL

name: link
description: Attach an area to a dossier: which connection it uses, and its keys

name: env
description: Add an environment's resources for an area to a dossier

name: field
description: Name one of an area's fields in a dossier, so prompts use the name

name: person
description: Add someone to a dossier's people, with the identity each system knows them by

name: wip-limit
description: Set how many items one person may have in progress at once

name: describe
description: Rename one of your own dossiers, or change its description

name: export
description: Write a dossier for sharing: into a repository's .toil/dossiers, or to one file

name: import
description: Copy a dossier into your own folder, adopting its bindings

name: unlink
description: Remove an area's section from a dossier, or one environment's

name: remove
description: Delete one of your own dossiers

name: onboard
description: Set up this repo: match each area of its dossier to your connections, add the ones you lack, then check it and test each
